values.en: Let $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{2}$ be **open in the Euclidean topology**. A **regular smooth parametrized surface** is a map $X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$, $(u,v)\mapsto X(u,v)=(x(u,v),y(u,v),z(u,v))$, smooth on $\Omega$ ($X\in C^{\infty}(\Omega)$, the standard $\mathrm{ContDiffOn}$ convention: only the restriction $X|_{\Omega}$ is used), and whose two partial derivatives $X_{u},X_{v}$ are linearly independent at every point of $\Omega$ (equivalently, the differential has rank $2$). The coordinate curves $u\mapsto X(u,v_{0})$ and $v\mapsto X(u_{0},v)$ are the images of the coordinate directions. A parametrized surface is an object with a chosen domain and parametrization, not yet a subset of $\mathbb{R}^{3}$; passing to a surface subset requires the local-sheet condition of a regular surface.
values.zh-CN: 设 $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{2}$ 在**欧氏拓扑下开**。**正则光滑参数曲面**是映射 $X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$，$(u,v)\mapsto X(u,v)=(x(u,v),y(u,v),z(u,v))$，在 $\Omega$ 上**光滑**（$X\in C^{\infty}(\Omega)$，即标准 $\mathrm{ContDiffOn}$ 约定：只使用限制 $X|_{\Omega}$），且两个偏导数 $X_{u},X_{v}$ 在 $\Omega$ 的每一点线性无关（等价地，微分秩为 $2$）。坐标曲线 $u\mapsto X(u,v_{0})$ 与 $v\mapsto X(u_{0},v)$ 是坐标方向的像。参数曲面是带有选定定义域与参数化的对象，还不是 $\mathbb{R}^{3}$ 的子集；要得到曲面子集还需正则曲面的局部开片条件。
